description:
Find WhatJobs listings that fit a person's background: searches up to 4 target job titles at once and ranks the jobs by how well the title matches and how many of their skills each listing mentions.

Use this when the user shares their CV, experience or skills and asks what jobs suit them, e.g. "Here's my CV, what should I apply for in Manchester?".

Inputs:
- job_titles: 1-4 job titles that fit the person (you choose them from what they shared).
- skills: up to 10 key skills or tools (e.g. "Python", "SQL", "forklift licence").
- location: where they want to work (the place to search).
- market: optional country code; if empty it is inferred from location. Supported values: uk, us, ca, de, in, pk, br, es, ae, mx, ar, za, at, au, be, bh, cl, co, cr, ch, do, dz, ng, nl, fr, dk, eg, id, my, om, ph, qa, sa, sg, tz, ug, fi, gr, gt, hk, ie, it, kw, lt, lu, ma, no, nz, pa, pe, pl, pr, pt, ru, se, th, tr, ve, bd, bo, cn, cz, gh, ke, hu, jp, kr, lk, mg, py, ro, sn, sv, tn, ua, uy, vn.

Pass only titles and skills. Never pass CV text, names, contact details or other personal data. The result includes a link to all matching jobs on WhatJobs. Results come only from WhatJobs. Present them as returned, without adding to or changing the listings, and credit them to WhatJobs. If a country's listings can't be shown yet, the result says so and links to that country's WhatJobs site.
name: match_jobs_to_profile
title: Match jobs to profile
